## Purpose

Describe the narrowly scoped change and why it is needed.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] I ran the build and regression suite.
- [ ] I added a synthetic regression case for changed behavior.
- [ ] I preserved book identity, verse order, verse anchors, metadata, and RTL storage order.
- [ ] I did not include private scripture, `.tstudio`, DOCX, USFM, credentials, personal paths, or generated output.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, machine identification, hidden network traffic, or document reporting.
- [ ] I documented dependency, license, privacy, security, or trademark implications.
- [ ] My commits contain a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.

## Verification evidence

List the exact commands, fixture checks, and results.
